parameters.query: SELECT DISTINCT m.name,m.ra,m.dec,a.match_type,o.obsid,o.obi,o.region_id,o.gti_obs,o.gti_end,o.livetime,o.detector,o.flux_significance_b,o.src_cnts_aper_b,o.src_rate_aper_b,o.flux_aper_b,o.var_index_b,o.conf_code,o.streak_src_flag FROM master_source m, master_stack_assoc a, stack_source s, stack_observation_assoc b, observation_source o WHERE m.name=a.name AND s.detect_stack_id=a.detect_stack_id AND s.region_id=a.region_id AND s.detect_stack_id=b.detect_stack_id AND s.region_id=b.region_id AND o.obsid=b.obsid AND o.obi=b.obi AND o.region_id=b.region_id AND o.obsid=23056 AND (m.dec BETWEEN -27.217751783 AND -27.168956676) AND (m.ra BETWEEN 267.139328719 AND 267.253215609)
